name: Starlink Group 15-18
destination_explanation: Even at this height there are faint wisps of atmosphere. They slowly drag satellites down, so anything here needs an occasional push to stay up.
slot_a_text: B1093 is out on its 18th flight. It came down on the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You, 574 km downrange. It last flew Starlink Group 15-27 41 days ago.
slot_b_text: Low Earth orbit is anywhere from about 160 to 2,000 km up, where a satellite laps the planet roughly every 90 minutes. Everything there is falling; it just keeps missing the ground.
